title: Animated List (Magic UI)
notes:
A list that animates each item in sequence with a delay. Used to showcase notifications or events on your landing page.

Install into a project: npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/animated-list

npm dependencies: motion

Original file: https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui/blob/main/apps/www/registry/magicui/animated-list.tsx
